tei:div.tei:p: 215)༄༅/ las ldan bu slob rnams la springs ba'i zhal gdams snying po'i don bsdus gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs dge'o// 216)e ma ho/ rigs kun yongs 'dus bdag cag 'gro ba'i mgon// kun tu bzang po dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul// 'khor lo'i mgon po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs// bdag rgyud chos dang 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// de la 'dir ngag tshab yi ge'i lam nas zhu ba ni/ snyan snyan tshig gi legs bshad dang spros pa bdag gis mi shes kyang*/ glen gtam gnad cig rgan mo mdzub khrid lta bu'i ngang nas khyed cag gi thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi gtam nyob cung zad zhu ba la/ sems khrid nyams len mdzad pa la sngar zhus 217)ltar blo ldog rnam pa bzhi'i don dran bzhin 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bya ba blos btang nas dben rir sgrub tshugs bzung ba gal che ba dang*/ nyams rtogs kyi yon tan kyang snying rus la rag las pa yin pas de gzhir bzhag dang bcas pas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang rgyud la brtag dpyad zhib par byas nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la kha phyogs pa ni gnad gal po che yin no/ rang rgyud chos dang 'gal yod phyin chad lta ba mtho mtho dang*/ sgom pa zab zab yin mdog byas kyang dper na shing sdong po'i khog pa rul ba 218)dang 'dra ste/ gzhan don phar zhog rang don kyang chud zos du 'gro ba las med pas na/ thog mar byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyis rang rgyud legs par sbyangs nas*/ bdag bas gzhan gces kyi bsam pas byang chub sems kyi gzhi bzung*/ yang dag pa'i chos dang bla ma mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas dag snang dang mos gus/ dad pa brtan pos bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi ye shes yon tan thams cad sāts+tsha dang bskos phor bzhin du rang rgyud la lon nges kyi brtson 'grus dang sdug bsran dgos pa ma gtogs/

mos gus dang dad brtson snying stobs med tshe bla ma sangs rgyas dngos sprul yin kyang byin rlabs 'jug pa shin tu dka' ba dper na rdo thog na myu gu smin pa mi srid pa dang*/ snod zhabs rdol gyis bcud mi 'dzin pa ltar rang rgyud log lta dang the tshom gyis bslad phyin chad yang dag pa'i chos lam lon pa shin tu dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan la bsam nas sgo gsum gcig dril gyi dad pa'i sgo nas bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba gal che/ sngon gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug na ro/ mar pa/ mi la rnams kyis kyang bla ma la dad pa dang mos gus thang lhod med par dus dang rnam pa thams cad 219)du sangs rgyas dngos su blta ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i chos la brtson 'grus dang snying stobs chen po'i sgo nas nyams su len par mdzad nas bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi ye shes yon tan thams cad bum pa gang byo'-i tshul du thob pa ltar/ rang cag rnams kyis kyang dben ri la sgrub tshugs bzung ste/ rnam g.yeng dang le lo spangs nas bla ma la mos gus/ mched grogs la dag snang*/ chos la brtson grus byas nas tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig bya snyam pas rang sems la dam bca' brtan po snying la bzung nas 'khor bar rgyab kyis phyogs pa gal che/ sngon thub pa'i dbang pos kyang shākya'i rgyal srid spangs nas khyim nas khyim med par rdzogs sangs rgyas pa dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas za hor gyi rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du spangs nas dur khrod brgyad la sogs par brtul zhugs kyi phrin las mdzad nas mthar 'ja' lus gzhon nu bum skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan yang rim byon gyi grub pa'i rig 'dzin thams cad kyis kyang rang yul rgyab tu phyogs/ mi yul dang du blangs/ dka' ba khyad du bsad/ lus srog pha mar ma bltas par gong ma'i 220)lam srol gtad pa bzhi la mdzad nas don gnyis 'grub pa sha stag yin pas na/

rang cag rnams kyis 'khor ba dang dam pa'i lha chos gnyis lhan du cis phyir 'grub/ de'i phyir na 'khor ba rgyab tu phyogs nas dben pa'i gnas su rang nyid gcig pur tshugs thub pa la gzhi bca'/ brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i man ngag la sgo gsum gcig dril du blo gtad nas yid khyed shes drag pos bla ma la gsol ba btab ste lus ngag yid gsum gyi ru shan dbye ba dang*/ sems byung gnas 'gro gsum/ gzugs dbyibs kha dog brtag pa sogs sngon du sbyangs pa'i don rnams legs par bsgom pa gal che/ lab sgron zhal lung las/ chos bshol byed na pha ma grogs kyang bdud// nye 'brel 'khor ba'i lcags sgrog rgyang spangs nas// dben rir blo tshugs byar med bya btang gis// sems rtsad bcad nas stong nyid nyams su longs/ gsungs pa bzhin no/ des na dang po gzhi lta ba zab mos snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gtan la phabs nas ye stong rtsa bral chen po'i don khong du chud par byas/ lam bsgom pas nyams len gyi gnad ma nor bar gsal 221)stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur par byas nas ngang gnas rang byung gi ye shes blos phar ma bcad/ sems kyis nang du mi bsdu/ kun rtog gis bcas bcos gang yang mi byed par rang babs de khar 'jog pa ni ngo bos ngo bo lam byed du 'dod pa yin pas/ sngon pasar khyed cag rnams la zhus pa ltar dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang byung gi rig pa'am/ ngang gnas kyi bsam gtan de ka blos bcos bslad gang yang mi byed par sku gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings ji lta ba bzhin du dad brtson snying stobs chen pos nyams su blangs nas go ba tsam du ma bzhag par don rang rgyud la lon nges re mdzad par ma 'chug rem rem/ de nyid las/ rang rig sku gsum lhun grub ngo bo la// dgag sgrub bcos ma'i chings su ma bcing bar// rang babs ngang las blo 'das don mthong na// gnyis med ye shes chen po'i gtan srid zin/

zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ lta sgom gyi grogs spyod pa'i tshul ni/ phyi'i spyod pa grong chog sogs la smyo chu 'thung nas shes pa bag med du mi gtong bar zhi ba dul ba dran shes bag yod dang ldan cing 222)so thar 'dul khrims kyi tshugs ma nyams pa dang*/ nang gi spyod pa mi dge ba bcu'i rnam par smin pa'i rgyu 'bras go ma myong ba lta bu mi byed par smon pa dang 'jug pa'i don la gzhi byas te/ rab sems can thams cad kyi don la rgyal po snying stobs can lta bu dang*/ min kyang byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i spyod pas byang sems kyi bslab pa dang mi 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags dbang gi dam tshig slob dpon drug mched bzhi/ sngags gsum/ phyag rgya bzhi/ gsang ba bcu dang*/ khyad par mdor bsdu na bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rnams srog la babs kyang dpral ba'i mig ltar bsrung ba ni sngags kyi dam tshig gi rtsa ba yin pas 'gal 'das zhig ral med par bsrung nas zab mo 'od gsal gyi don la thang lhod med par bsgom pa dang gsang ba'i spyod pa ni/ rkyen ngan thog tu babs dus tha mal rang ga ma lta bu ma yin par/ khyung dkar gyi gshog rtsal rdzogs pa ltar nyon mongs pa'i rkyen las dben cing gang snang thams cad rgyu rkyen 'brel ba'i chos nyid tsam ma gtogs don la bden med sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu gzhi'i rang gdangs/ ye shes kyi rol pa/ rig pa'i rgyan yin par ngo shes 223)ngang gnas kyi gding grol thog de kar bca' ba dang*/ 'gyu 'phro'i rtog tshogs thams cad spang blang re dogs gang yang mi byed par gang snang thams cad chos nyid kyi rol par shes nas snang srid dag mnyam chen por rang shar rang grol du gding thob par bya ba ni lta sgom gyi grogs spyod pa ya bral du ma song ba yin no/ o rgyan chen pos/ nga lta ba nam mkha' bas kyang mtho// las rgyu 'bras bag phye bas kyang zhib/

gsungs pa dang*/ zhal lung las/ lta dang sgom pa spyod pa gsum// rnal 'byor pa yi lam grogs yin// chos dbyings klong du tha dad med// cer grol dgongs par la bzla'o/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ de ltar lam zab mo lta sgom spyod pa'i lam gyi rim pa rnams go lo dang thos lor ma bzhag par don thams cad gzhan la sgro 'dogs gcod mi dgos par rang rgyud la lon nges pa zhig ma byas na chos nyid kyi don go ba tsam du lus na rgyu 'bras la skur pa btab nas lam log par 'gro nyen yod pas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci ma log pa lta sgom gyi phu thag nang nas chod pa zhig 224)gal che rem rem/ thub pa'i dbang pos/ bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ mdor na dus rnams kun tu shes pa bag med kha yan du ma btang bar dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung la/ phyi'i spyod pa/ nang gi bsam pa/ gsang ba'i nyams len thams cad rang babs kyi dran pa'i ngang ma bor ba re ma byas na/ bdag gis khyed cag rnams la 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi gnad gsang rnams bstan kyang go yul du shor nas lus na rang gzhan rnams mtshams med pa'i las gsog byed du 'gro ba la tshegs med pa lta bu yin pas/ dran shes bag yod kyi sgo nas go don rgyud la lon thabs re snying rus mdzad par ma 'chug rem rem/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas/ nyams na bun 'dra ste yal nas 'gro/ go ba lhan pa 'dra ste gog nas 'gro/ gsungs pa bzhin no/ de dag gi mthar thug 'jog mtshams ni/ rang byung gi rig pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba de ka gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dbang du ma btang bar gnas lugs kyi ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub 225)pa'i stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa de chos sku/ rang bzhin 'gags pa med pa srid zhi gnyis kyi yon tan thams cad ma btsal yongs grub chen por ye ldan du lhun gyis grub pa'i cha la longs sku/

thugs rje gsal la 'dzin pa med pa rang grol kun khyab chen po'i cha la sprul sku ste/ sku gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi ngo bo ni rang rig 'gyur ba med pa rnam thar sgo gsum dang ldan pa spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba de la lta bas thag bcad/ sgom pas ngang bskyangs/ spyod pas la dor/ 'bras bu rang sa zin par bya ba ni gnad kyi man ngag lags so/ zhal lung las/ mi 'gyur mi shigs rig pa'i klong*// sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med// rnam par mi rtog 'od gsal dbyings// rang klong rang grol 'bras bu'o/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ de ltar man ngag gsal 'debs glen gtam 'di// skal ldan las 'phro ldan pa'i bu slob la// mdo med 'chol mo su kha badz+ra gyis/ snying nas sems dkar ngag tshab yi ger phul// snying 'dra'i skal ldan res 'ga' ma gtogs pa'i// snying chung tha mal yongs la bka' rgya 226)mdzod// snying po'i don 'di yal bar ma dor bar// snying stobs drag pos rtse gcig nyams blangs na// snying thig chos kyi lam zab 'di yis lon// rang gzhan don gnyis ma 'bad lhun grub nas// rang rig kun bzang rgyal sar tshe 'dir bgrod// rang cag rnams kyi zab lam khyad chos lags// rang la de tsam ma gtogs chos gzhan med// skal ldan khyed cag rnams kyi dpal du shar// bskal par 'bad pa mi dgos grol ba'i lam// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas par nges// zhes pa 'di yang mdo smad gsang lung yang dgon gyi bla ser 'dus sde skal bzang rnams la thugs dam gsal 'debs su snyoms las pa mdo med 'chol mo su kha badz+ra gyis ser dgon dben khrod dga' ba'i tshal nas zla ba dang po'i tshes gnyis dge bar pañca nam mkha'i mdangs 'dzin dang dri bral lha reg gi skyes bcas gus phul/ dge'o//
